G0846.def:
**αὐτός**, -ή, -ό,
_determinative pron._, in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, _HGG_, §1399).
1. Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii);
(1) **self** (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, [[Luk.5.37|Luk.5:37]] αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, [[Jhn.2.25|Jhn.2:25]] αὐ.ὑμεῖς, [[Jhn.3.28|Jhn.3:28]] καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, [[Rom.15.14|Rom.15:14]] αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, [[Jhn.2.24|Jhn.2:24]] αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, [[Mrk.2.25|Mrk.2:25]] ὑμεῖς αὐ., [[Mrk.6.31|Mrk.6:31]] esp. (as freq in cl.) αὐ. ὁ, [[Mat.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[Mrk.6.17|Mrk.6:17]], [[Jhn.16.27|Jhn.16:27]], [[1Th.3.11|1Th.3:11]], al.; in late Gk., sometimes weakened, ἐν αὐτῇ τ. ὥρᾳ, **in that hour**, [[Luk.10.21|Luk.10:21]] (M, _Pr._, 91; MM, see word);
(2) emphatic, **he, she, it** (M, _Pr._, 86; Bl., §48, 1, 2, 7), [[Mat.1.21; 12.50|Mat.1:21, 12:50]], [[Luk.6.35|Luk.6:35]], al.; pointing to some one as master (cl.), [[Mat.8.24|Mat.8:24]], [[Mrk.4.38|Mrk.4:38]], al.; αὐ., καὶ αὐ. = οὗτος, ὁ δε (BL, §48, 1), [[Mat.14.2|Mat.14:2]], [[Mrk.14.15, 44|Mrk.14:15, 44]], [[Luk.1.22; 2.28|Luk.1:22, 2:28]], al.
2. In oblique cases (cl.), for the simple pron. of 3rd of person(s), **he, she, it**, [[Mat.7.9; 10.12; 26.44|Mat.7:9, 10:12, 26:44]], al.; with ptcp. in genitive absol., [[Mat.9.18|Mat.9:18]], [[Mrk.13.1|Mrk.13:1]], al. (for irreg. constructions, V. Bl., §74, 5); pleonastically after the relative (cf. Heb. אֲשֶׁר לוֹ; WM, 184ff.; Bl., §50, 4; MM, see word), [[Mrk.7.25|Mrk.7:25]], [[Rev.3.8; 7.2|Rev.3:8, 7:2]], al.; in constr. ad sensum, without proper subject expressly indicated, [[Mat.4.23|Mat.4:23]], [[Act.8.5|Act.8:5]], [[2Co.2.13|2Co.2:13]], al.; genitive αὐτοῦ = ἐκείνου, [[Rom.11.11|Rom.11:11]], [[1Th.2.19|1Th.2:19]], [[Tit.3.5|Tit.3:5]], [[Heb.2.4|Heb.2:4]].
3. ὁ, ἡ, τὸ αὐ., **the same**: [[Heb.1.12; 13.8|Heb.1:12, 13:8]]; τὸ αὐ., ποιεῖν, [[Mat.5.46, 47|Mat.5:46, 47]], al.; φρονεῖν, [[Rom.12.16; 15.5|Rom.12:16, 15:5]], [[Php.2.2|Php.2:2]], al.; τὰ αὐ., [[Act.15.27|Act.15:27]], [[Rom.2.1|Rom.2:1]], al.; κατὰ τὸ (τὰ) αὐ. (MM, see word), [[Act.14.1|Act.14:1]], [[Luk.6.23|Luk.6:23]], al.; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐ., **together** (MM, see word), [[Mat.22.34|Mat.22:34]], [[Act.1.15|Act.1:15]], al.; ἓν κ. τὸ αὐ., [[1Co.11.5; 12.11|1Co.11:5, 12:11]]; with dative (cl.), [[1Co.11.5|1Co.11:5]] with a noun, λόγος, [[Mrk.14.39|Mrk.14:39]] μέτρος, [[Php.1.30|Php.1:30]] πνεῦμα, [[1Co.12.4|1Co.12:4]]
(AS)

G0897.def:
**Βαβυλών**, -ῶνος, ἡ (בָּבֶל, Heb. form of Assyr. Bab-ili, **Gate of God**),
**Babylon**: [[Mat.1.11, 12, 17|Mat.1:11, 12 17]], [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]]" (LXX) ; symbolically, of _Rome_: [[Rev.14.8; 16.19; 17.5; 18.2, 10, 21|Rev.14:8 16:19 17:5 18:2, 10, 21]], and prob. also [[1Pe.5.13|1Pe.5:13]]†
(AS)

G0863.def:
**ἀφ-ίημι**,
[in LXX for נשׂא, נוח hi., נתן, סלח ni., עזב, etc. ;]
1. **to send forth, send away, let go**: of divorce (_DB_, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), [[1Co.7.11-13;|1Co.7:11-13]] of death, τ. πνεῦμα ([[Gen.35.18|Gen.35:18]], Hdt., al.), [[Mat.27.50|Mat.27:50]] (φωνήν, **to utter a cry**, [[Mrk.15.37|Mrk.15:37]] of debts, **to remit, forgive** (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, [[Mat.18.27|Mat.18:27]] τ. ὀφειλήν, [[Mat.18.32|Mat.18:32]] esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, [[Mat.9.2|Mat.9:2]], [[Rom.4.7|Rom.4:7]]" (LXX), [[1Jn.1.9|1Jn.1:9]], al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, _Pr._, 119), [[Mark.2.5|Mrk.2:5]], [[Luk.11.4|Luk.11:4]] Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, _Pr._, 38), [[Luk.5.23|Luk.5:23]]
2. **to leave alone, leave, neglect**: [[Mat.4.11; 5.24; 15.14|Mat.4:11 5:24 15:14]], [[Mrk.1.20, 31|Mrk.1:20, 31]] [[Jhn.4.3, 28|Jhn.4:3, 28]] al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, [[Mrk.7.8|Mrk.7:8]] τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]] τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, [[Rev.2.4|Rev.2:4]] ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, _Pr._, 14; Dalman, _Words_, 21f.), [[Mat.13.36; 22.22|Mat.13:36 22:22]], [[Mrk.8.13|Mrk.8:13]], al.
3. **to let, suffer, permit**: [[Mat.3.15|Mat.3:15]] with accusative, [[Mat.3.15; 19.14|Mat.3:15, 19:14]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[Mat.5.40|Mat.5:40]] with inf. pres., [[Mat.23.14|Mat.23:14]], al.; aor., [[Mrk.5.37|Mrk.5:37]], al.; in late Gk. (M, _Pr._, 175f.), before ἵνα, [[Mrk.11.16|Mrk.11:16]], [[Jhn.12.7|Jhn.12:7]]; with subjunct. (M, _Pr._, l.with; Bl., §64, 2), [[Mat.7.4; 27.49|Mat.7:4 27:49]], [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Luk.6.42|Luk.6:42]] (see further MM, see word).
(AS)

G0853.def:
**ἀφανίζω **
(ἀφανής), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם ni., שָׁמַד hi., etc. ;]
1. to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.).
2. Later (MM, see word)
(a) **to destroy**: [[Mat.6.19-20;|Mat.6:19-20]]
(b) **to disfigure**: [[Mat.6.16|Mat.6:16]] Pass., **to vanish**: [[Jas.4.14|Jas.4:14]] to perish: [[Act.13.41|Act.13:41]](LXX).†
(AS)

G0837.def:
**αὐξάνω**
(and the earlier form αὔξω, [[Eph.2.21|Eph.2:21]], [[Col.2.19|Col.2:19]]; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for פָּרָה ;]
1. trans., **to make to grow**: [[1Co.3.6-7|1Co.3:6-7]], [[2Co.9.10|2Co.9:10]]. Pass., **to grow, increase, become greater**: [[Mat.13.32|Mat.13:32]], [[Mrk.4.8|Mrk.4:8]], [[2Co.10.15|2Co.10:15]], [[Col.1.6|Col.1:6]]; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, [[Col.1.10|Col.1:10]] εἰς σωτηρίαν, [[1Pe.2.2|1Pe.2:2]]
2. In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., **to grow, increase**: of plants, [[Mat.6.28|Mat.6:28]], [[Luk.12.27; 13.19|Luk.12:27 13:19]]; of infants, [[Luk.1.80; 2.40|Luk.1:80 2:40]]; of a multitude, [[Act.7.17|Act.7:17]] of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, [[Act.6.7; 12.24; 19.20|Act.6:7 12:24 19:20]]; of Christ as a leader, [[Jhn.3.30|Jhn.3:30]] of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, [[Eph.4.15|Eph.4:15]] εἰς ναόν, [[Eph.2.21|Eph.2:21]] ἐν χάριτι, [[2Pe.3.18|2Pe.3:18]] τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, [[Col.2.19|Col.2:19]] (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).†
(AS)

G0899.def:
**βάθος**, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX for מְצוּלָה ,תַּחְתִּי, etc. ;]
**depth**: [[Mat.13.5|Mat.13:5]], [[Mrk.4.5|Mrk.4:5]], [[Rom.8.39|Rom.8:39]], [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]]; τὸ β., **the deep sea**: [[Luk.5.4|Luk.5:4]] metaphorically, β. πλούτου . . . Θεοῦ, [[Rom.11.33|Rom.11:33]] τὰ β. τ. Θεοῦ (the Divine counsels), [[1Co.2.10|1Co.2:10]] ἡ κατὰ βάθους πτωχεία, **deep poverty**, [[2Co.8.2|2Co.8:2]]†
(AS)

G0873.def:
**ἀφ-ορίζω **
[in LXX (Cremer, 805 f.) for בָּדַל hi., סָגַר hi., נוּף hi., רוּם hi etc. ;]
(a) **to mark off by boundaries from, separate from**: with accusative, [[Act.19.9|Act.19:9]], [[Gal.2.12|Gal.2:12]]; id. before ἐκ (ἀπό), [[Mat.13.49; 25.32|Mat.13:49 25:32]] (MM, see word); of excom­munication, [[Luk.6.22|Luk.6:22]] Pass., absol., [[2Co.6.17|2Co.6:17]]
(b) **to set apart, devote to a special purpose **(before εἰς): with accusative, [[Gal.1.15|Gal.1:15]] Mid., [[Act.13.2|Act.13:2]], [[Rom.1.1|Rom.1:1]] (_DB_, iii 588).†
(AS)

G0801.def:
**ἀ-σύνετος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Deu.32.21|Deu.32:21]] (נָבָל). [[Job.13.2|Job.13:2]] (נָפַל), [[Psa.92.6|Psa.92:6]] (כְּסִיל), [[Psa.76.5|Psa.76:5]], [[Wis.2.1-24|Wis.2:1-24]], [[Sir.6.1-37|Sir.6:1-37]] * ;]
**without understanding or discernment**: [[Mat.15.16|Mat.15:16]], [[Mrk.7.18|Mrk.7:18]] (Swete, in l), [[Rom.1.21, 31; 10.19|Rom.1:21, 31 10:19]] (for an ex. of its use in the moral sense, see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0856.def:
**ἀφεδρών**, -ῶνος, ὁ
(cf. ἄφεδρος, [[Lev.12.5|Lev.12:5]]) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, see word),
**a privy, drain**: [[Mat.15.17|Mat.15:17]], [[Mrk.7.19|Mrk.7:19]] (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).†
**ὀχετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὀχέω, to carry) [in Sm.: [[Job.22.24|Job.22:24]], [[Psa.65.10|Psa.65:10]] al. ;]
1. a water-pipe, channel.
2. **the intestinal canal**: [[Mrk.7.19|Mrk.7:19]], WH, mg. (for ἀφεδρών).†
(AS)

G0835.def:
**αὐλίζομαι**
(αὐλή), [in LXX chiefly for לוּן ;]
1. prop., to lodge in a courtyard.
2. to lodge in the open.
3. **to pass the night, lodge **(LXX; MM, see word): [[Mat.21.17|Mat.21:17]], [[Luk.21.37|Luk.21:37]].†
(AS)

G0888.def:
**ἀ-χρεῖος**, -ον
(χρεῖος, useful), [in LXX: [[2Sa.6.22|2Ki.6:22]] (שָׁפָל), Ep. [[Jer.17.1-27|Jer.17:1-27]] * ;]
**useless, unprofitable**: [[Mat.25.30|Mat.25:30]], [[Luk.17.10|Luk.17:10]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0833.def:
**αὐλή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חָצֵר ;]
1. in Hom., **an open courtyard before a house, hence, an enclosure in the open, a sheepfold**: [[Jhn.10.1, 16|Jhn.10:1, 16]]
2. **the court, courtyard, round which a house is built**: [[Mat.26.3, 58; 26.69|Mat.26:3, 58 26:69]], [[Mrk.14.54, 66; 15.16|Mrk.14:54, 66 15:16]] [[Luk.11.21; 22.55|Luk.11:21 22:55]], [[Jhn.18.15|Jhn.18:15]]; τ. ναοῦ, [[Rev.11.2|Rev.11:2]] a dwelling, **a palace **(so, accusative to Grimm-Th., see word): [[Mat.26.3, 58|Mat.26:3, 58]], [[Mrk.14.54; 15.16|Mrk.14:54 15:16]], [[Luk.11.21|Luk.11:21]], [[Jhn.18.15|Jhn.18:15]] (but see MM, see word; cf. also _DB_, ii, 25, 287).†
(AS)

G0859.def:
**ἄφεσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀφίημι), [in LXX for יוֹבֵל, דְּרוֹר, etc. (see Deiss., BS, 98 ff.; MM, see word) ;]
1. **dismissal, release**: [[Luk.4.18|Luk.4:18]]
2. Metaphorical, of sins (never in LXX), pardon, remission of penalty: ἁμαρτιῶν, [[Mat.26.28|Mat.26:28]], [[Mrk.1.4|Mrk.1:4]], [[Luk.1.77; 3.3; 24.47|Luk.1:77 3:3 24:47]], [[Act.2.38; 5.31; 10.43; 13.38; 26.18|Act.2:38 5:31 10:43 13:38 26:18]], [[Col.1.14|Col.1:14]]; παραπτωμάτων, [[Eph.1.7|Eph.1:7]] absol., [[Mrk.3.29|Mrk.3:29]], [[Heb.9.22; 10.18|Heb.9:22 10:18]] (cf. _DB_, ii, 56; _DCG_, i, 437, ii, 605; Cremer, 297 f.).†
_SYN._: πάρεσις, which see (and cf. Tr., § xxxiii) (AS)

G0847.def:
**αὐτοῦ **
_adv., prop. neut. genitive_ of αὐτός, [in LXX for פֹּה, בָּזֶה ;]
**there**: [[Mat.26.36|Mat.26:36]], [[Mrk.6.33|Mrk.6:33]], WH, mg., [[Luk.9.27|Luk.9:27]], [[Act.15.34|Act.15:34]], WH, mg., R, mg., [[Act.18.19; 21.4|Act.18:19 21:4]] .†
(AS)

G0851.def:
**ἀφ-αιρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX (Cremer, 615 f.) for סוּר, עָבַר, H7311 כָּרַת, etc. (35 words in all) ;]
**to take from, take away, take off**: with accusative, τὸ ὠτίον, [[Mat.26.51|Mat.26:51]], [[Mrk.14.47|Mrk.14:47]] (ὠτάριον, WH), [[Luk.22.50|Luk.22:50]] (οὖς); ὄνειδος, [[Luk.1.25|Luk.1:25]] before ἀπό, [[Rev.22.19|Rev.22:19]], [[Luk.16.3|Luk.16:3]] (mid.); pass., C. genitive, [[Luk.10.42|Luk.10:42]] ἀ. ἁμαρτίος, [[Heb.10.4|Heb.10:4]], [[Rom.11.27|Rom.11:27]] (mid.) (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0844.def:
**αὐτόματος ** -ον, and -η, -ον
(etym. doubtful; see Boisacq, Prellwitz, see word), [in LXX, [[Lev.25.5, 11|Lev.25:5, 11]], [[2Ki.19.29|4Ki.19:29]] (סָפִיחַ), [[Jos.6.5|Jos.6:5]], [[Job.24.24|Job.24:24]], [[Wis.17.6|Wis.17:6]] * ;]
1. of persons, acting of one's own will.
2. **Of inanimate things and natural agencies, of itself, of its own accord**: γῆ [[Mrk.4.28|Mrk.4:28]] (MM, see word); πύλη, [[Act.12.10|Act.12:10]]†
(AS)

G0877.def:
**ἀφροσύνη**, -ης, ἡ
(ἄφρων), [in LXX for אִוֶּלֶת, נְבָלָה, etc. ;]
**foolishness**: [[Mrk.7.22|Mrk.7:22]], [[2Co.11.1; 11.17; 11.21|2Co.11:1 11:17 11:21]].†
(AS)

G0818.def:
**ἀτιμάζω**
(ἄτιμος), [in LXX for בּוּז, קָלָה, etc. ;]
**to dishonour, insult**: [[Mrk.12.4|Mrk.12:4]], TTr., mg., WH, [[Luk.20.11|Luk.20:11]], [[Jhn.8.49|Jhn.8:49]], [[Rom.2.23|Rom.2:23]], [[Jas.2.6|Jas.2:6]]; pass.: [[Act.5.41|Act.5:41]], [[Rom.1.24|Rom.1:24]] (cf ἀτιμάω).†
(AS)

G0886.def:
**ἀ-χειρο-ποίητος**, -ον
(χειροποίητος)
**not made by hands**: [[Mrk.14.58|Mrk.14:58]], [[2Co.5.1|2Co.5:1]]; metaphorically, περιτομή ἀ. (i.e. spiritual ), [[Col.2.11|Col.2:11]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0803.def:
**ἀσφάλεια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσφαλής), [in LXX for בָּטַח, etc. ;]
1. firmness.
2. **certainty**: [[Luk.1.4|Luk.1:4]]
3. **security**: [[Act.5.23|Act.5:23]], [[1Th.5.3|1Th.5:3]].
(In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; see MM, see word; M, _Th._, l.with)†
(AS)

G0828.def:
**Αὔγουστος**, -ου, ὁ
(Lat.), **Augustus, the Roman Emperor**: [[Luk.2.1|Luk.2:1]] (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0868.def:
**ἀφ-ίστημι **
[in LXX for סוּר, מָעַל, etc. (41 words in all) ;]
1. trans. in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put away, lead away; metaphorically, **to move to revolt**: [[Act.5.37|Act.5:37]]
2. Intrans. in pf., plpf., 2 aor., **to stand off, depart from, withdraw from**: with genitive, [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]] before ἀπό, [[Luk.4.13; 13.27|Luk.4:13 13:27]], [[Act.5.38; 12.10; 15.38; 19.9; 22.29|Act.5:38 12:10 15:38 19:9 22:29]], [[2Co.12.8|2Co.12:8]]; metaphorically, ἀπὸ ἀδικίας, [[2Ti.2.19|2Ti.2:19]] ἀπὸ θεοῦ, (fall away, apostatize), [[Heb.3.12|Heb.3:12]] Mid. (exc. 1 aor., WH. is trans.), **to withdraw oneself from, absent oneself from**: [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]] metaphorically, **fall away, apostatize**: absol., [[Luk.8.13|Luk.8:13]] with genitive, [[1Ti.4.1|1Ti.4:1]] (MM, see word; Cremer, 308).†
(AS)

G0816.def:
**ἀτενίζω**
(ἀτενής, strained, intent; τείνω), [in LXX: I [[Est.6.28|Est.6:28]], [[3Ma.2.26|3Ma.2:26]] * ;]
**to look fixedly, gaze **(MM, see word): with dative of person(s), **gaze upon**: [[Luk.4.20; 22.56|Luk.4:20 22:56]], [[Act.3.12; 10.4; 14.9; 23.1|Act.3:12 10:4 14:9 23:1]]; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[Act.3.4; 6.15; 13.9|Act.3:4 6:15 13:9]]; metaphorically, [[Act.1.10; 7.55; 11.6|Act.1:10 7:55 11:6]], [[2Co.3.7; 3.13|2Co.3:7 3:13]].†
(AS)

G0879.def:
**ἀφ-υπιόω**, -ῶ
(ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: [[Gen.28.11|Gen.28:11]] * ;]
1. to awake from sleep (Anth.).
2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, see word), **to fall asleep**: [[Luk.8.23|Luk.8:23]]†
(AS)

G0876.def: **foam **, of the sea, (Iliad by Homer): of an angry lion, **foam, froth **, (Iliad by Homer); ἀπ᾽ ἀνθρώπων ἀφρόν **frothy blood **, (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

G0878.def:
**ἄφρων**, -ον genitive -ονος
(φρήν), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, נָבָל, etc. ;]
**without reason, senseless, foolish, expressing "want of mental sanity and sobriety, a reckless and inconsiderate habit of mind" **(Hort; cf. MM, see word): [[Luk.11.40; 12.20|Luk.11:40 12:20]], [[Rom.2.20|Rom.2:20]], [[1Co.15.36|1Co.15:36]], [[2Co.11.16; 12.6; 12.11|2Co.11:16 12:6 12:11]], [[1Pe.2.15|1Pe.2:15]]; opposite to φρόνιμος, [[2Co.11.19|2Co.11:19]] to συνιέντες, [[Eph.2.17|Eph.2:17]]†
(AS)

G0811.def:
**ἀσώτως **
_adv._ (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), [in LXX for סָרַר, [[Pro.7.11|Pro.7:11]] * ;]
**wastefully**: [[Luk.15.13|Luk.15:13]]
(EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, _NTD_, 79).† (AS)

G0840.def:
**αὐστηρός**, -ά, -όν
(αἄω, to dry up) [in LXX: [[2Ma.14.30|2Ma.14:30]] * ;]
prop., stringent, harsh to the taste. Metaphorical, in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, **strict, severe **(as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): [[Luk.19.21-22|Luk.19:21-22]]†
_SYN._: σκληρός (Tr., § xiv) (AS)

G0817.def:
**ἄτερ **
_prep._, [in LXX: [[2Ma.12.15|2Ma.12:15]] * ;]
in cl. most frequently in poets; without, **apart from**: with genitive, [[Luk.22.6, 35|Luk.22:6, 35]] (for exx. from π., see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0824.def:
**ἄ-τοπος**, -ον
(τόπος), [in LXX: [[Job.4.8; 11.11|Job.4:8 11:11]], [[Pro.30.20|Pro.30:20]], al., for אָוֶן, etc. ;]
1. out of place, not befitting.
2. **marvellous, strange **(of symptoms, Hipp.): [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]] hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense,
3. **improper, unrighteous **(so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, _Th._, l.with; MM, see word): [[Luk.23.41|Luk.23:41]], [[Act.25.5|Act.25:5]], [[2Th.3.2|2Th.3:2]].†
(AS)

G0855.def:
**ἄφαντος**, -ον
(φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, see word)
**invisible, hidden**: [[Luk.24.31|Luk.24:31]]†
(AS)

G0822.def:
**ἀτμίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX for עָנַן, תִּמֹּר, etc. ;]
**vapour**: [[Jas.4.14|Jas.4:14]] ἀ. καπνοῦ, [[Act.2.19|Act.2:19]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G0858.def:
**ἀφελότης**, -ητος, ἡ
= cl. ἀφέλεια (see MM, see word),
**simplicity**: [[Act.2.46|Act.2:46]]†
(AS)

G0880.def:
**ἀφωνος**, -ον
(φωνή) [in LXX: [[Isa.53.7|Isa.53:7]] (עָלַם ni.), [[Wis.4.19|Wis.4:19]], [[2Ma.3.29|2Ma.3:29]] * ;]
**dumb, speechless**: [[Act.8.32|Act.8:32]] (LXX); of idols (MM, see word), [[1Co.12.2|1Co.12:2]] of beasts, [[2Pe.2.19|2Pe.2:19]] τοσαῦτα γένη φωνῶν καὶ οὐδὲν ἄ.—so many kinds of voices and none voiceless, i.e. without signification, **unintelligible**: [[1Co.14.10|1Co.14:10]]†
(AS)

G0887.def:
**ἀχλύς**, -ύος, ἡ
[in Aq.: [[Ezk.12.7|Eze.12:7]] Sm.: [[Job.3.5|Job.3:5]] * ;]
a mist, esp. a dimness of the eyes: [[Act.13.11|Act.13:11]] (see Tr., _Syn._, § with).†
(AS)

G0827.def:
**αὐγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Isa.59.9|Isa.59:9]] (נְגֹהָה), [[2Ma.12.9|2Ma.12:9]] * ;]
1. **brightness **
2. Later (as in M_Gr._; MM, see word), **daylight, dawn**: [[Act.20.11|Act.20:11]] (Cremer, 118).†
_SYN._: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; _DB_, iii, 44a; Tr., _Syn._, § xlvi). (AS)

G0867.def:
**ἄφ-ιξις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἀφικνέομαι), [in LXX: [[3Ma.7.18|3Ma.7:18]] * ;]
in cl. usually, **arrival; rarely, departure**: [[Act.20.29|Act.20:29]] (so in π., cf. MM, see word; M, [[Pro.26.1-28|Pro.26:1-28]], n.).†
(AS)

G0804.def:
**ἀσφαλής**, -ές
(ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), [in LXX for אָשַׁר pu., etc. ;]
**certain, secure, safe**: [[Act.21.34; 22.30; 25.26|Act.21:34 22:30 25:26]], [[Php.3.1|Php.3:1]], [[Heb.6.19|Heb.6:19]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0849.def:
**αὐτό-χειρ**, -ρος, ὁ, ἡ
(αὐτός, χείρ),
**with one's own hand**: [[Act.27.19|Act.27:19]]†
(AS)

G0800.def:
**ἀ-σύμφωνος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Wis.18.10|Wis.18:10]], Da, LXX, [[Bel.1.15|Bel 1:15]] * ;]
**dissonant, discordant**; metaphorically, **at variance**: πρὸς ἀλλήλους, [[Act.28.25|Act.28:25]]†
(AS)

G0819.def:
**ἀτιμία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἄτιμος) [in LXX for כְּלִמָּה, קָלוֹן, etc. ;]
**dishonour, disgrace**: [[1Co.11.14|1Co.11:14]], [[2Co.6.8|2Co.6:8]]; εἰς ἀ., [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]], [[2Ti.2.20|2Ti.2:20]]; ἐν ἀ., [[1Co.15.43|1Co.15:43]] κατ᾽ ἀ., [[2Co.11.21|2Co.11:21]] πάθη ἀτιμίας, base passions, [[Rom.1.26|Rom.1:26]]†
(AS)

G0808.def:
**ἀσχημοσύνη**, -ης, ή
(ἀσχήμων), [in LXX chiefly for עֶרְוָה ;]
**unseemliness**: [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]] (MM, see word); euphemism for ἡ αἰσχύνη, as frequently in LXX, **shame, nakedness**: [[Rev.16.15|Rev.16:15]]†
(AS)

G0802.def:
**ἀ-σύν-θετος**, -ον
(συντίθεμαι ν. M, _Pr._, 222; MM, see word), [in LXX: [[Jer.3.7-11|Jer.3:7-11]] (בָּגַד)* ;]
**false to engagements, not keeping covenant, faithless **(MM, see word): [[Rom.1.31|Rom.1:31]]†
(AS)

G0861.def:
**ἀφθαρσία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἄφθαρτος), [in LXX: [[Wis.2.23; 6.19|Wis.2:23 6:19]], [[4Ma.9.22|4Ma.9:22]] [[4Mac.17.12|4Mac 17:12]] * ;]
**incorruptibility, immortality**: [[Rom.2.7|Rom.2:7]], [[1Co.15.42; 15.50; 15.53-54|1Co.15:42 15:50 15:53-54]], [[2Ti.1.10|2Ti.1:10]]; ἀγαπώντων . . . ἐν ἀ., [[Eph.6.24|Eph.6:24]] (see AR, in l).†
ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ
(φθείρω), [in LXX: [[Hag.2.17|Hag.2:17]] (שְׁדֵפָה)* ;]
**uncorruptness**: [[Tit.2.7|Tit.2:7]] (Rec. ἀφθορία).†
(AS)

G0889.def:
**ἀχρεόω** (Rec. -ειόω, Polyb., LXX), -ῶ
(ἄχρεος = ἀχρεῖος) [in LXX (-ειόω) for אָלַח ni., etc. ;]
**to make useless, unprofitable**: pass., [[Rom.3.12|Rom.3:12]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G0874.def:
**ἀφ-ορμή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Ezk.5.7|Eze.5:7]] (הָמוֹן), [[Pro.9.9|Pro.9:9]], [[3Ma.3.2|3Ma.3:2]] * ;]
prop., a starting point; in war, a base of operations; metaphorically, **an occasion, incentive, opportunity **(MM, see word): [[2Co.11.12|2Co.11:12]], [[Gal.5.13|Gal.5:13]]; ἀφ. λαμβάνειν, [[Luk.11.24|Luk.11:24]], WH, mg., [[Rom.7.8, 11|Rom.7:8, 11]]; ἀφ. διδόναι, [[2Co.5.12|2Co.5:12]], [[1Ti.5.14|1Ti.5:14]].*
(AS)

G0896.def:
**Βάαλ** (Rec. βαάλ), ὁ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, **lord**),
**Baal**: [[Rom.11.4|Rom.11:4]] (LXX). The fem. art. here agrees with the usage of LXX, where, following a similar Hebrew practice (בֹּשֶׁת for בַּעַל), αἰσχύνη appears to have been substituted in reading for the written Βάαλ (cf. [[1Ki.18.19|3Ki.18:19]]), and to account for the frequently use of the fem. art. bef. Β. The usage, however, is not general, and in the passage cited in Ro ([[1Ki.19.18|3Ki.19:18]]), LXX reads τῷ Β. †
(AS)

G0864.def:
**ἀφ-ικνέομαι**, -οῦμαι
[in LXX for בּוֹא, etc. ;]
perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, _Pr._, 247), **to arrive at, come to, reach**: metaphorically (MM, see word), [[Rom.16.19|Rom.16:19]]†
(AS)

G0807.def:
**ἀσχημονέω**, -ῶ
(ἀσχήμαων), [in LXX: [[Ezk.16.7, 22; 16.39; 23.29|Eze.16:7, 22 16:39 23:29]] (עֶרְיָה); [[Deu.25.3|Deu.25:3]] (קָלָה ni.)* ;]
**to act unbecomingly, behave dishonourably**: [[1Co.13.5|1Co.13:5]] before ἐπί, ib. [[1Co.7.36|1Co.7:36]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0809.def:
**ἀσχήμων**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σχῆμα) [in LXX: [[Gen.34.7|Gen.34:7]] (נְבָלָה), [[Deu.24.1|Deu.24:1]] (עֶרְוָה), [[Wis.2.20|Wis.2:20]], Da TH [[Sus.1.63|Sus 1:63]], [[2Ma.9.2|2Ma.9:2]] * ;]
1. shapeless.
2. **uncomely, unseemly**: [[1Co.12.23|1Co.12:23]]†
(AS)

G0836.def:
**αὐλός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἄω, to blow), [in LXX chiefly for חָלִיל ;]
**a pipe**: [[1Co.14.7|1Co.14:7]]†
(AS)

G0823.def:
**ἄ-τομος**, -ον
(τέμνω), [in Sm.: [[Isa.54.8|Isa.54:8]] (MM, see word) * ;]
**indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment**: ἐν ἄ., [[1Co.15.52|1Co.15:52]]†
(AS)

G0826.def:
**αὐγάζω**
(αὐγή), [in LXX: [[Lev.13.24-28, 38; 14.56|Lev.13:24-28, 38 14:56]] (בֹּהֶרֶת) [[Lev.13.39|Lev.13:39]] (כֵּהֶה)* ;]
1. Trans. (cl.), to irradiate.
2. Intrans.
(a) (poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word)
(b) **as in LXX, to shine forth**: [[2Co.4.4|2Co.4:4]] (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).†
(AS)

G0830.def:
**αὐθαίρετος**, -ον
(αὐτός, αἱρέομαι), [in Sm.: [[Exo.35.5, 22|Exo.35:5, 22]] * ;]
1. self-chosen.
2. **of one's own accord**: [[2Co.8.3; 8.17|2Co.8:3 8:17]].†
(AS)

G0841.def:
**αὐτάρκεια**, -ας, ἡ
(αὐτάρκης, which see),
(a) **sufficiency **(MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, _NTD_, 57), [[2Co.9.8|2Co.9:8]]
(b) **contentment**: [[1Ti.6.6|1Ti.6:6]]†
(AS)

G0860.def:
**ἁφή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), [in LXX for נֶגַע, frequently in Le ;]
**a joint **(MM, see word): [[Eph.4.16|Eph.4:16]], [[Col.2.19|Col.2:19]] (Lft., in l).†
(AS)

G0810.def:
**ἀσωτία**, -ας, ή
(ἀ- neg., σώζω), [in LXX: [[Pro.28.7|Pro.28:7]] (זָלַל), [[2Ma.6.4|2Ma.6:4]] * ;]
**prodigality, wastefulness, profligacy**: [[Eph.5.18|Eph.5:18]], [[Tit.1.6|Tit.1:6]], [[1Pe.4.4|1Pe.4:4]] (MM, see word).†
_SYN._: ἀσέλγεια, q.v (AS)

G0872.def:
**ἀφ-οράω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[4Ma.17.10|4Ma.17:10]] (είς θεόν)* ;]
(a) to look away from all else at, **fix one's gaze upon**: metaphorically (MM, see word), [[Heb.12.2|Heb.12:2]]
(b) **simply, to see**: ἀφίδω (see: ἀπεῖδον, and Lft., Phi., in l; MM, see word), [[Php.2.23|Php.2:23]] (see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G0842.def:
**αὐτάρκης**, -ες
(αὐτός, ἀρκέω), [in LXX: [[Pro.30.8|Pro.30:8]] (חֹק), [[Sir.5.1; 11.24; 31.28; 40.18|Sir.5:1 11:24 31:28 40:18]], [[4Ma.9.9|4Ma.9:9]] * ;]
as in cl., in philosophical sense, **self-­sufficient, independent; subjectively, contented**: [[Php.4.11|Php.4:11]] (in non-lit. π., the word means simply enough, sufficient; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0813.def:
**ἀ-τακτος**, -ον
(τάσσω), [in LXX: [[3Ma.1.19|3Ma.1:19]] * ;]
out of order, out of place (Lat. inordinatus), frequently of soldiers not keeping the ranks, or an army in disarray (cf. [[3Ma.1.19|3Ma.1:19]]); hence, metaphorically, **irregular, disorderly **(see previous word): [[1Th.5.14|1Th.5:14]]†
(AS)

G0812.def:
**ἀτακτέω -ῶ**
(ἄτακτος),
primarily, of soldiers marching, **to be out of order**, **to quit the ranks**; hence, metaphorically, to be remiss, fail in the performance of duty (in π., of truancy on the part of an apprentice): [[2Th.3.7|2Th.3:7]] (on ἀ. and its cognates, see M, _Th._, 152 ff.; MM, s.vv.).†
(AS)

G0831.def:
**αὐθεντέω**, -ῶ
(αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. [[Wis.12.6|Wis.12:6]] cf. -ία, [[3Ma.2.29|3Ma.2:29]] -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word)
**to govern, exercise authority over**: [[1Ti.2.12|1Ti.2:12]]†
(AS)

G0866.def:
**ἀ-φιλ-άργυρος**, -ον
**without love of money, not avaricious**; [[1Ti.3.3|1Ti.3:3]], [[Heb.13.5|Heb.13:5]]. (For other instances, see MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0898.def:
**βαθμός**, -οῦ, ὁ, Ion. form of βασμός
(βαίνω, **to step**), [in LXX [[1Sa.5.5|1Ki.5:5]] (מִפְתָּן), [[4Ki.20.9, 10 11|4Ki.20:9, 10 11]] (מַעֲלָה), [[Sir.6.36|Sir.6:36]] * ;]
**a step** (4Ki, l.with, of **degrees** of a dial); metaphorically, a **degree, standing**: [[1Ti.3.13|1Ti.3:13]]†
(AS)

G0865.def:
**ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος**, -ον
**without love of good**: [[2Ti.3.3|2Ti.3:3]] (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0829.def:
**αὐθάδης**, -ες
(αὐτος, ἥδομαι), [in LXX: [[Gen.49.3|Gen.49:3]], 7 (עַז), [[Pro.21.24|Pro.21:24]] (יָהִיר)* ;]
**self-pleasing, arrogant**: [[Tit.1.7|Tit.1:7]], [[2Pe.2.10|2Pe.2:10]] (Cremer, 654).†
_SYN._: φίλαυτος (see Tr., _Syn._, § xciii) (AS)

G0890.def:
**ά-χρηατος**, -ον
[in LXX: [[Hos.8.8|Hos.8:8]] (חֵפֶץ אַיִן), [[Wis.2.11|Wis.2:11]], [[Sir.16.1|Sir.16:1]], al. ;]
**useless; unserviceable**: opposite to εὔχρηστος, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G0854.def:
**ἀφανισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀφανίζω), [in LXX chiefly for שַׁמָּה, שְׁמָמָה ;]
**vanishing**: [[Heb.8.13|Heb.8:13]]†
(AS)

G0894.def:
**ἄψινθος**, -ου, ἡ
(also ἀψίνθιον, τό; ἀψινθία, ἡ),
**wormwood**: as a proper name, [[Rev.8.11|Rev.8:11]]†
(AS)
